messages:
celeste: Kicking off thread: need a single artifact that reconciles routing policy primitives, multi-region fallback behavior, and tenant isolation packaging for next month's roadmap review. Owners and draft by Tue?

omar: +1. My proposal: split into (1) policy primitives, (2) rollout gates, (3) migration path. Policy primitives should be tiny and runtime-evaluable.

li: From sales: customers ask for three packages: 'Isolated' (hard residency + reserved nodes), 'Affinity' (regional preference, softer guarantees), 'Shared' (best-effort, cost-first). We should map clear SLAs and pricing deltas.

harper: Ops note: we can't enable any 'Isolated' canary until per-tenant telemetry, eviction automation, and capacity headroom checks exist. Gate: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 + eviction_rate metric + cache_warmup. If missing, block. :no_entry:

miguel: Prioritization idea: create a short backlog with each item scored on customer_impact, infra_work, and rollback_risk. We'll pick top-3 for the PI. I'll run the sheet.

celeste: Owners: Omar (policy schema + examples), Harper (pre-canary probes & runbooks), Li (customer mapping & contract snippets), Miguel (prioritization). Docs-bot can scaffold a central doc + branch.

Docs-bot: created doc https://redwood.internal/docs/tenancy-routing-roadmap-4823456789 and branch routing/tenancy-roadmap-4823456789

omar: Draft policy sketch (compact JSON-esque):
```
{ "lane": "isolated", "residency": "eu-west-1/hard", "fallback": ["affinity","shared"], "model_compat": {"quant_ok": false}, "quality_budget_pct": 1 }
```
Will add rollout phases: feature_flag_canary -> phased_ab -> full.

harper: Runbook snippet: pre-canary checks: telemetry completeness, capacity_headroom > 12%, kv_cache_warm > 60% in 5m. Eviction mitigation: if eviction_rate > 0.4% over 10m -> scale burst + shift new sessions to fallback lane + page SRE.

li: I'll add three anonymized customer quotes and example contract clauses (residency wording, SLA p99 target, termination on region downtime). Also call out migration costs.

miguel: I'll score initial asks and post the prioritization heatmap in the doc. Suggest we weight customer_impact x2.

celeste: Nice. One more infra callout: include 'quality_guard' linking to eval-suite id and a 'warmup_schedule' field so rollout tooling can orchestrate staggered traffic shifts. Example schedule: [10,30,60,100].

omar: Adding quality_guard and warmup_schedule fields now. Will PR by EOD. Meeting to review Tue 10am?

celeste: Tue 10am works. Please add your sections to the doc by EOD Mon so I can synthesize for the roadmap review. Thanks all. :sparkles:
